denial.payer_remark: Service not deemed medically necessary on the information submitted.

visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-05-04
Patient: 61-year-old man, established patient.
Chief complaint: left knee pain after an injury
History: twisted the left knee 10 days ago; it has locked twice since.
Examination: medial joint-line tenderness with a positive McMurray test; ligaments stable.
Assessment: suspected medial meniscal tear.
Plan: MRI of the left knee without contrast.
Signed: treating clinician. 2026-05-04.

expected.rationale: The policy supports a knee MRI for a suspected meniscal tear with a positive examination finding. The note records locking, joint-line tenderness and a positive McMurray test, so the criterion is met without relying on duration.
